Looking at the patch‑clamp (−70 to 0 mV) trace in panel A, the four sensors settle to different steady‑state values. ASAP1ncp (orange) shows essentially no change, ASAP1 (black) about −20 %, ArcLight Q239 (blue) about −25 to −30 %, and ASAP2s (green) the largest, about −30 to −35 % ΔF/F. By 2000 ms the responses are at steady state, so the sensor with the greatest change is ASAP2s.

[ANSWER]E[/ANSWER]
